grid: 10m BNG aligned to frozen 3km study, central100x100 core; continuous decoded RGB bilinear once, SCL nearest; single GDAL thread
terrain: mean each10x10 native1m block; central-difference normals on full300x300 analysis grid; true-north Sun transformed to BNG at core centre
ray: native1m nearest samples at core cell centre, distances2..1000m inclusive step1m; full finite support required, any sample above Sun ray excludes cell; non-terrain and beyond1km visibility unknown
primaryBrightness: RGB weighted sum0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; absolute Pearson correlation versus mu and standard deviation as within-stratum spread; report each band too
minimumGate: nominal eligibility first, require both native SCL4/5 overall>=100, every heldout quadrant>=20 and each complementary training muP95-P05>=0.2; any failure stops before fitting without resizing
sensitivity: five fixed Sun cases; recompute geometry/masks, apply same gates and folds, no tuned angle
texture: adjacent eligible same-SCL pixels within same heldout fold, absolute difference divided by pair mean, p05/median/p95; excluded/fold boundary edges omitted
spectral: positive RGB R/G and B/G ratio p05/median/p95 and fractional changes; no spectral classification
visual: fullcore and four fixed folds, before/after same010 fixed RGB transfer (rho-0.02)/0.28 clipped for display only, gamma1; numeric data never clipped
materialization: heldout predictions only, no full-data refit or extra method; transient corrected numeric arrays outside Git
failure: protocol minimum failure stops INCONCLUSIVE, distinct from failed valid normalization; invalid individual fits no-change per protocol
noThresholdAddition: texture/colour sanity reported and inspected; no invented numerical acceptance threshold replaces frozen qualitative guardrails
